title: MZT Skopje Aerodrom sweep Madzari 3-0 for 13th North Macedonian title
description: MZT Skopje Aerodrom extended their stranglehold on North Macedonian basketball with a ruthless 3-0 sweep of Madzari in the MTEL Super Liga Finals, sealing a 13th championship with an 80-74 road victory in Game 3 before 500 fans at Madjari's home court on Saturday. Coach Vasko Atanasov's side trailed 26-21 after a first quarter in which Madzari's A. Hot and T. Armstrong combined for early damage. But MZT's championship composure surfaced in the second period a 25-16 burst flipped the game to 46-42 at halftime, and the visitors never relinquished the lead from there. A 16-14 third quarter and 18-18 fourth saw MZT manage the closing stretch with the poise of serial winners, converting a perfect 15-of-15 from the free-throw line across the contest.
imageCaption: MZT Skopje Aerodrom sweep Madzari 3-0 for 13th North Macedonian title (Photo: mkd.basketball)

title: MZT Skopje earn 12th Prva Liga title
description: TFT - MZT Skopje 53-77 MZT Skopje have been crowned Prva Liga champions. They upset TFT on the road in Game 4 to clinch the 12th League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by MZT Skopje. TFT managed to win third quarter 18-15. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. MZT Skopje dominated down low during the game scoring 44 of its points in the paint compared to TFT's 24 and made 21-of-27 free shots (77.8 percent) during the game. They outrebounded TFT 42-31 including a 33-21 advantage in defensive rebounds. 25 personal fouls committed by TFT helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The former international swingman Vojdan Stojanovski (194-1987) fired 17 points and 4 assists for the winners. The former international power forward Bojan Krstevski (206-1989, agency: BIG) chipped in 11 points and 7 rebounds. Four MZT Skopje players scored in…
imageCaption: MZT Skopje earn 12th Prva Liga title (Photo: kfsm.mk)

title: MZT Skopje earn fifth straight Prva Liga title
description: Pelister - MZT Skopje 67-78 MZT Skopje conquered Prva Liga title. They upset Pelister on the road to capture the fifth straight title. The guests trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 39-24 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. MZT Skopje forced 21 Pelister turnovers. It was a great evening for American point guard John Gillon (183-1994, college: Syracuse, agency: BIG) who led his team to a victory scoring 15 points, 6 rebounds and 5 assists. Croatian-Bosnian power forward Marko Bakovic (205-1993) helped adding 15 points and 5 rebounds. Four MZT Skopje players scored in double figures. MZT Skopje's coach Vasko Atanasov used an eleven-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. The best for the losing side was point guard Aleksandar Kostoski (186-1988) with 19 points and 6 rebounds and Bosnian guard Stefan Mijovic…
imageCaption: MZT Skopje earn fifth straight Prva Liga title (Photo: kfsm.mk)

title: MZT Skopje celebrate Prva Liga title
description: Pelister - MZT Skopje 83-92 MZT Skopje claimed Prva Liga title. They outscored Pelister on the road tonight to sweep the championship series conquering the trophy. The victory marked the 10th League title for MZT Skopje. The guests trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 2-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 92-83. MZT Skopje shot the lights out from three sinking 12 long-distance shots on high 54.5 percentage. It was a great evening for the former international swingman Vojdan Stojanovski (194-1987) who led his team to a victory scoring 33 points (!!!) and 7 rebounds (on 12-of-14 shooting from the field). American point guard Dustin Ware (183-1990, college: Georgia, agency: Slash Sports) helped adding 16 points. The best for the losing side was the former international power forward Andrej Maslinko (208-1997) with 15 points and 7…
imageCaption: MZT Skopje celebrate Prva Liga title (Photo: KK MZT Skopje)

title: MZT Skopje defend Prva Liga title
description: Pelister - MZT Skopje 93-102 MZT Skopje upset Pelister on the road to defend Prva Liga title. MZT Skopje made 23-of-25 free shots (92.0 percent) during the game. They also forced 21 Pelister turnovers. Worth to mention a great performance of Montenegrin Nemanja Milosevic (204-1987, college: WKU, agency: 011 Sports) who helped to win the game recording 31 points and 6 rebounds (on 11-of-13 shooting from the field) and international swingman Vojdan Stojanovski (194-1987) who added 17 points, 6 assists and 4 steals during the contest. At the losing side Serbian forward Nikola Malesevic (202-1989, college: URI) responded with 21 points and 8 rebounds (on 9-of-11 shooting from the field) and Serbian center Igor Kesar (210-1992, agency: Mansfield and Associates) scored 19 points and 6 rebounds. Both teams had five players each who scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench players…
imageCaption: MZT Skopje defend Prva Liga title (Photo: mztskopjeaerodrom.mk)

title: MZT Skopje claim Prva Liga title
description: MZT Skopje - Euro Nickel 89-78 MZT Skopje celebrated Prva Liga title. They edged Euro Nickel to sweep the championship series. The hosts trailed by 2 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 2-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 89-78. The best player for the winners was international point guard Andrej Magdevski (192-96) who scored 21 points and 6 rebounds. International power forward Bojan Krstevski (206-89, agency: BIG) chipped in 16 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists (on 6-of-7 shooting from the field). Four MZT Skopje players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was Croatian-Bosnian center Robert Rikic (219-90) who recorded a double-double by scoring 16 points, 12 rebounds and 6 blocks and point guard Jane Petrovski (181-87) added 15 points respectively.
imageCaption: MZT Skopje claim Prva Liga title (Photo: kfsm.mk)
